from cyclopts import App
from cyclopts.sources import Toml
from pathlib import Path

# Create a sample pyproject.toml for demonstration
Path("pyproject.toml").write_text("""
[tool.mycli]
name = "Alice"
greeting = "Hello"
verbose = true
count = 2
""")

# Create app with TOML config source
app = App(
    config_sources=[
        Toml("pyproject.toml", config_key="tool.mycli")
    ]
)

@app.default
def main(
    name: str = "World",
    greeting: str = "Hey",
    verbose: bool = False,
    count: int = 1,
):
    """Greet someone. Defaults come from [tool.mycli] in pyproject.toml."""
    msg = f"{greeting}, {name}!"
    for _ in range(count):
        print(msg)
    if verbose:
        print(f"[verbose] count={count}, name={name}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app()
